synthesis: Three historical Makati audit findings have later response or implementation-evidence records in the indexed public trail, but none of the three currently has finding-specific closure established by an explicit later status mapping.
boundaries: Unresolved refers to documentary continuity in the indexed trail, not proof that the underlying condition continued.
Aggregate implementation counts are not assigned to a specific finding unless the later source identifies that finding or recommendation.
Related later controls or reporting are retained as follow-up evidence but are not treated as closure without explicit item-level continuity.
The 2024 SEF compliance audit remains source-only and is excluded from the three finding-level trails because finding-level text is not currently retrievable.
